args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding per FIN-212, but round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented behavior.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

`round_money` in src/money.py claimed to implement banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `test_half_even` to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `src/money.py`.
- Quantize to cents with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit 08d3cd5986 passed.
